consent.2: Ibisubizo byawe bidufasha kukwereka ibyo wakwigerezaho.
consent.3: Nta zina cyangwa nimero ya telefone dusaba. Nyuma yo kwemera, tubara abasura nta mazina (si ku bari munsi y'imyaka 18). Nuhitamo kwibutswa, tubika kode ya telefone yawe. Hagarika igihe cyose.

result.rough: Ibisubizo byawe byari byihuse cyangwa bimeze kimwe, bityo ibi ni ibigereranyo. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.
q.c002: Iyo ndi mu bantu benshi, ndananirwa nkifuza guceceka.
q.c003: Iyo ndi mu bantu benshi, numva mfite imbaraga nyinshi.
q.c004: Nshobora kwicara jyenyine amasaha menshi nkora ikintu kimwe.
q.c005: Nkunda gusetsa abantu cyangwa kuvuga inkuru.
q.c008: Nezezwa no kwigisha umuntu uko ikintu gikorwa.
q.c010: Nkunda gukorera hanze, mu zuba cyangwa mu mvura.
q.c011: Nkunda gushushanya, umuziki, cyangwa gutunganya ibintu bikaba byiza.
q.c013: Nkunda guhinga ibimera cyangwa korora amatungo.
q.c015: Nkunda kwiga ibintu bishya mu mashusho cyangwa mu bitabo.
q.c019: Nkunda kuyobora itsinda no gufata ibyemezo.
q.c020: Nkunda igitekerezo cyo gutangiza ubucuruzi bwanjye buto.
q.c021: Nkunda iyo urutonde n'impapuro bitunganyijwe neza kandi ari ukuri.
q.c022: Nkunda kugenzura utuntu duto kugeza byose bimeze neza.
q.c023: Nkunda iminsi ntazi icyo ari bubeho.
q.c024: Nkora neza iyo hari akazi kenshi kandi byihuta.
q.c025: Nkora neza iyo nkora buhoro kandi nituje.
q.c026: Nkunda kugenda umubiri wanjye umunsi wose.
q.c028: Nahitamo gukorera imbere, mu cyumba gituje.
q.c029: Nkunda kugerageza ibintu bishya, nubwo byananirana.
q.c030: Nkunda ko amafaranga yanjye atagira ikibazo kandi angana buri kwezi.
q.c031: Nkunda ko abantu benshi babona ibyo nkora.
q.c032: Nkunda gukora neza bucece, kure y'abantu benshi.
q.c035: Nshaka kwihitiramo uko nkora akazi kanjye.
q.c036: Nshaka kuba umuhanga cyane mu bumenyi bumwe.
q.c037: Ni ingenzi ko akazi kanjye gafasha abandi.
q.c039: Nshaka ko abantu banyubaha kubera akazi kanjye.
q.c040: Nshaka kunoza ubuzima mu mudugudu wanjye cyangwa mu mujyi.
q.t003: Nyabuneka subiza Yego kuri iyi karita.
q.d001: Nshobora gukorera ahantu hari urusaku umunsi wose.
q.d003: Nshobora kuvugana n'abantu mutaziranye umunsi wose.
q.d004: Nshobora gukora mu zuba no mu mvura.
q.d005: Nshobora gutembera cyangwa kurara kure y'urugo.
q.d006: Nshobora kureba kuri ecran amasaha menshi.
q.f001.a: Kubaka cyangwa gukosora ikintu n'amaboko yanjye
q.f001.b: Kuvugana n'abantu ngo dukemure ikibazo cyabo
path.webapp: Gukora imbuga za interineti na porogaramu
j.fix.NO_TIME: Kora iminota 10 gusa uyu munsi. Nayo irabarwa.
j.fix.NO_DATA: Koresha radiyo, isomero, cyangwa ubaze umuntu uri hafi. Nta interineti bisaba.
j.fix.FORGOT: Hitamo isaha imwe buri munsi kandi ubibwire inshuti.
j.fix.AFRAID: Kora ufatanyije n'inshuti. Tangirana n'agace gato cyane.
j.quiet: Uburyo butuje: ohereza ubutumwa aho kuvuga.
j.finished2: Ikurikiraho: subiramo, kora byinshi, usabe akazi gato nyako.
step.journalism.0: Umva amakuru umwe kuri radiyo. Ibaze: umunyamakuru yabajije iki mbere?
step.journalism.1: Subiramo ikintu kimwe cyabaye mu mudugudu wawe mu nteruro 5.
step.journalism.2: Fata amajwi y'amasegonda 60 avuga ikibazo nyacyo cyo mu gace kawe.
step.journalism.3: Ohereza amajwi yawe ku bantu 5. Ubabaze: ese yumvikanye?
step.journalism.4: Vugana n'umunyamakuru umwe wo mu gace kanyu. Mubaze uko yabonye inkuru ya mbere.
step.repair.0: Reba umuntu usana telefone cyangwa radiyo. Ibaze: yagenzuye iki mbere?
step.repair.1: Fungura igikoresho cyangiritse cyera kandi uvuge izina rya buri gice ubona.
step.repair.2: Sana inenge imwe nto: buto irekuye, aho bacomeka charger handuye, cyangwa umugozi.
step.repair.3: Ereka abantu 3 icyo wasanze. Ubabaze: mwakwishyura ibi?
step.repair.4: Sura iduka rimwe risana. Baza icyo bifuza ko bari bamenye batangira.
step.tailoring.0: Reba neza imyenda 3. Witegereze uko imiguno n'imbavu bikozwe.
step.tailoring.1: Wigane umugozi umwe woroshye cyangwa umuguno ku mwenda ushaje.
step.tailoring.2: Dodera ikintu kimwe gito: isakoshi, ingofero, cyangwa agapande.
step.tailoring.4: Vugana n'umudozi. Mubaze uko yabonye umukiriya wa mbere.
step.farming.0: Genda mu murima cyangwa mu busitani. Witegereze ibiri kwera neza n'ibitari kwera.
step.farming.1: Tera imbuto cyangwa ingemwe 5 nk'uko umuhinzi mwiza abigenza.
step.farming.2: Fata neza ikibanza gito mu cyumweru. Andika ibyo ubona.
step.farming.3: Ereka umuhinzi mugenzi wawe ikibanza cyawe. Mubaze icyo yakora.
step.farming.4: Baza umuhinzi cyangwa itsinda ry'abahinzi uko bagurisha umusaruro.
step.cooking.0: Reba umuntu uteka ifunguro. Witegereze uko bikurikirana, igihe, n'uburyohe.
step.cooking.1: Teka iryo funguro ubwawe mu rugo.
step.cooking.2: Teka ku bantu 2 maze uhindure ikintu kimwe ubwawe.
step.cooking.3: Ubabaze: ni iki cyari cyiza, ni iki kitari cyiza?
step.cooking.4: Baza umutetsi cyangwa utegura amafunguro uko ashyiraho ibiciro.
step.hair.0: Reba umusokozi akora. Witegereze uko afata ibikoresho n'uko avuga.
step.hair.1: Wigane uburyo bworoshye bumwe ku nshuti cyangwa kuri wowe.
step.hair.2: Kora uburyo bumwe bworoshye uhereye ku ntangiriro ukageza ku musozo.
step.hair.3: Ereka abantu 3 ibyavuyemo. Ubabaze icyo bakunze.
step.hair.4: Baza nyiri salon uko utangira abona umukiriya wa mbere.
step.teaching.0: Reba umwarimu mwiza. Witegereze uko asobanura igitekerezo kimwe kigoye.
step.teaching.1: Sobanura ikintu kimwe uzi, mu ijwi riranguruye, mu magambo yoroshye.
step.teaching.2: Igisha umwana cyangwa inshuti ikintu kimwe gito mu minota 10.
step.teaching.4: Baza umwarimu cyangwa utanga amasomo uko yabonye abanyeshuri ba mbere.
step.sales.0: Reba umucuruzi mwiza. Witegereze uko asuhuza n'uko asoza igurisha.
step.sales.1: Wigane uburyo asuhuza igihe uvugana n'umuntu uyu munsi.
step.sales.2: Gurisha cyangwa uhane ikintu kimwe gito umuntu uzi.
step.sales.3: Baza abantu 3: kuki mwaguze, cyangwa kuki mutaguze?
step.sales.4: Baza nyiri iduka uko abona abakiriya buri munsi.
step.bookkeeping.0: Reba ikayi y'iduka. Witegereze ibyandikwa buri munsi.
step.bookkeeping.1: Wandukure umunsi umwe w'igurisha ku rutonde rusukuye.
step.bookkeeping.2: Bika inyandiko za buri munsi z'amafaranga yawe mu minsi 3.
step.bookkeeping.3: Ereka umuntu urutonde rwawe. Mubaze: ese rurumvikana?
step.bookkeeping.4: Baza nyiri iduka niba akeneye ubufasha ku nyandiko ze.
step.webapp.0: Reba videwo imwe ngufi ivuga uko urubuga rwa interineti rukorwa.
step.webapp.1: Wigane urupapuro ruto cyane: umutwe, ifoto, na buto imwe.
step.webapp.2: Kora urubuga rw'urupapuro rumwe ruvuga ikintu ukunda.
step.webapp.3: Rwereke abantu 3. Ubabaze: ni iki kitumvikana?
step.webapp.4: Andikira umuhanga mu gukora porogaramu. Mubaze uko yatangiye.
step.media.0: Reba amashusho cyangwa amapositeri 3 ukunda. Witegereze urumuri n'amabara.
step.media.1: Wigane ifoto cyangwa ipositeri imwe uko ushoboye kose.
step.media.2: Kora ifoto, videwo ngufi, cyangwa ipositeri yawe bwite.
step.media.4: Baza umufotozi cyangwa umushushanyi wo mu gace kanyu uko abona abakiriya.
step.tourism.0: Umva umuyobora abashyitsi cyangwa urebe videwo y'urugendo. Witegereze uko avuga inkuru.
step.tourism.1: Bwira umushyitsi inkuru y'ahantu uzi, mu nteruro 5.
step.tourism.2: Tegura urugendo rw'iminota 30 rwo kwerekana agace kawe.
step.tourism.3: Genda n'inshuti 2 muri urwo rugendo. Ubabaze icyabashimishije.
step.tourism.4: Vugana n'umuyobozi w'abashyitsi cyangwa umukozi wa hoteli. Mubaze uko batangiye.
step.interpreting.0: Umva amakuru mu rurimi rumwe. Witegereze amagambo uzi mu ndimi zombi.
step.interpreting.1: Vuga interuro ngufi imwe mu ndimi ebyiri.
step.interpreting.2: Hindura mu ijwi riranguruye itangazo rigufi cyangwa ubutumwa.
step.interpreting.3: Baza inshuti izi indimi zombi: ese ni byo?
step.interpreting.4: Baza umuntu usemura uko yabonye akazi ka mbere.
step.construction.0: Reba abubatsi cyangwa abasudira aho bakorera. Witegereze uko akazi gakurikirana.
step.construction.1: Wigane umurimo umwe woroshye ufatanyije n'umufasha: gupima, gushyiraho ikimenyetso, cyangwa gutema.
step.construction.2: Kora ikintu kimwe gito: akabati, akabaho ko kwicaraho, cyangwa ikadiri.
step.construction.4: Baza umwubatsi cyangwa nyiri atelier niba wamufasha umunsi umwe.
step.driving.0: Reba umumotari cyangwa umushoferi akora. Witegereze uko ategura inzira.
step.driving.1: Menya imihanda y'agace kawe. Shushanya ikarita yoroshye uyifite mu mutwe.
step.driving.2: Tegura inzira nziza z'ingendo 3 mu mujyi.
step.driving.3: Ereka umumotari cyangwa umushoferi gahunda yawe. Mubaze icyabuze.
step.driving.4: Baza umumotari cyangwa umushoferi uko utangira abona akazi mu mutekano.
remind.hint: Si itegeko. Ubutumwa bumwe bugufi niba utinze iminsi 2. Wabuhagarika igihe cyose.
remind.denied: Imenyesha ryafunzwe. Ribemerere mu igenamiterere rya browser.
remind.unsupported: Iyi telefone cyangwa browser ntishobora kwerekana ibyibutsa.
remind.error: Ntibyakunze gufungura ibyibutsa. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.
remind.ios: Kuri iPhone: kanda Share, hanyuma Add to Home Screen, maze ufungure Cooker aho kugira ngo wibutswe.
j.minor: Uri munsi y'imyaka 18? Genda ujyanye n'umubyeyi, umwarimu cyangwa undi muntu mukuru wizeye. Ntugahure wenyine n'umuntu utazi.
j.h.NO_DATA: Nta interineti? Koresha radiyo, isomero cyangwa ubaze umuntu uri hafi.
j.h.NO_MONEY: Nta mafaranga akenewe. Koresha ibyo usanganywe.
j.h.SCHOOL: Kora ibi nyuma y'ishuri cyangwa mu mpera z'icyumweru.
q.c041: Nkunda iyo umuntu ambwira neza uko nkora akazi kanjye.
q.c042: Nkunda kugerageza ibintu byinshi kurusha gukora kimwe neza cyane.
q.c043: Akenshi nkora ku bw'ibyo nkeneye, si ku bw'abandi.
q.c044: Ntacyo bintwaye iyo amafaranga azamuka cyangwa agabanuka.
q.c045: Sinkeneye ko abantu bamenya akazi kanjye.
q.c046: Ntekereza cyane ku buzima bwanjye kurusha ubw'umudugudu wanjye.
about: Cooker igufasha kubona impano n'ibyo ukunda. Tukuyobora mu ntambwe nto, kandi ibyibutsa biraza vuba, kugira ngo ubigereho.
